legacy_routing_score.basis: Fraction of demand >= 0.5 cells within 20 routing cells of any track; mixed POI/population/centre demand, not resident coverage.

population.basis: Great-circle distance from native population pixel centres to station coordinates; union without double counting.

catchments.interpretation: Radial station-access sensitivity; barriers and entrance paths unverified.

population.denominator: Sum of valid native population-count pixels inside the city bounding box; no scaling to catalogue population.
limitations: Population year/boundary differs from the catalogue; counts are not current census counts.

source.nodata: Source nodata/out-of-extent and invalid values excluded and reported; never filled with people.
source.pixel_selection: Native pixel centres inside the city bbox; no resampling.

transfers.basis: Declared passenger-transfer topology; no pedestrian accessibility, timetable or travel-time acceptance implied.
